formal_statement: ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 4 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∑ f : Fin 4 ↪ Fin 4, ∏ i, (1 + t (i, f i))) = 24) ∧ Module.finrank ℂ L = 6
plain_statement: SEARCH GAP, possibly false: exhibit a linear space L of 4 x 4 complex matrices of dimension exactly 6 on which the sum over all permutations f of the product of (1 + t(i, f(i))) stays equal to 24, its value at t = 0. That is the same as all sums of k x k subpermanents of t vanishing on L. Dimension 5 is on our record (unchecked, exact arithmetic); the conjectured bound p + q - 2 = 6 allows 6. A witness is an explicit basis; a refutation is the bound 5.
title: Search: a level space of 4 x 4 complex matrices of dimension 6 (one above the best on our record)
